summary: Gates G2 (pilot dia), G4 (fan) and G5 (exhaust) fail. A plain box with one DC opening: the heatsink, the fan with its lid intake opening and fan pilots, and all exhaust slots are missing. Board standoff pilots are 1.70 mm (M2) not 2.4-2.6. Lid plate is 2.4, not 4.8-6.0. Score is an estimate.

defects.what: Standoff pilots are M2-sized and shallow

defects.where: lid.stl plate Z 18.7-21.1 (ray casts at X 20, 40, 60, Y 30 hit 2 faces: solid)
defects.what: No fan pilots in the lid and no fan placed (layout.json holds only perfboard, DC jack and 2 capacitors)
defects.expected: 4 pilots on the 32.0 pattern, dia 2.4-2.6, depth 4.0-(lid-0.8)

defects.what: No fan frame: the 5.0 mm fan-to-tall-part gap is unverified

defects.where: base.stl +X wall (inner X 81.1, outer 83.5); expected slots Y 12-56, Z 7-27
defects.what: No exhaust slots; rays at Y 15, 30, 45 and Z 10 are blocked by the +X wall
defects.expected: sum of slot area >= 567 mm2 (at least 8 slots, 2-4 wide, >= 10 tall)

defects.what: No intake opening in the lid
defects.expected: area 680-1158 mm2 inside the bore, centre within 0.5 of the fan axis

defects.what: Heatsink (20 x 12 x 20) and fan not declared; capacitors placed at (30,30) and (40,30), Ø10, touching each other (centres 10.0 apart)
All remaining fan and exhaust L3s are missing or unverified
Board clearance 1.1 to walls, solder side 4.1 (floor top -5.7, board bottom -1.6), DC opening dia 11.81 centred Y 30, Z 5.5 with 0.4 plug clearance; these pass
